recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-12346 unless a future terminology decision changes Common Languages membership.
issue_request: FHIR-12346 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU2 change request to add en-US to the Common Languages value set page at valueset-languages.html.
initial_application: Historical commit 43c0810c74eadeb1efbd6bafca4d55f055c9d830, '#12346: add en-US to common language set', added the en-US concept to source/terminologies/valueset-languages.xml. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-12346 commit existed on the combined branch before this reconciliation.
additional_context: The linked Zulip #implementers thread records the omission as an oversight and led directly to GF#12346. Later Common Languages maintenance commits changed nearby language metadata, but the current source still retains en-US. The value set remains a core terminology source referenced by active StructureDefinition bindings to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/languages.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because source/terminologies/valueset-languages.xml already contains code en-US with display English (United States).
